tha-ap384:1.1: Labujaphaladāyaka.] Nagare Bandhumatiyā āsim ārāmiko tadā / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ gacchantam anilañjase. // //
tha-ap384:2.1: Labujassa phalaṃ gayha Buddhaseṭṭhass' adās' ahaṃ / ākāse ṭhito santo paṭigaṇhi mahāyaso. // //
tha-ap384:3.1: Vittisañjananaṃ mayhaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhāvahaṃ / phalaṃ Buddhassa datvāna vippasannena cetasā // //
tha-ap384:4.1: Adhigacchiṃ tadā pītiṃ vipulañ ca sukhuttamaṃ / uppajjate va ratanaṃ nibbattassa yahiṃ tahiṃ. // //
tha-ap384:5.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
